component.name: homelinter
component.summary: Find, organize, deduplicate, and archive files in your home directory

description.p: homelinter scans your home directory, proposes safe moves and duplicate deletions, and executes only the plan you approve. It runs as a local service on the loopback interface and opens its interface in an app-mode window of the browser you already have.
Nothing is moved or deleted without confirmation, and no file leaves your machine unless you enable an optional online metadata provider.
